_doc: jCodeMunch MCP — token-efficient AST code retrieval. Clone: ~/GitHub/jcodemunch-mcp. Install: uvx jcodemunch-mcp. Config: ~/.code-index/config.jsonc
_pi_omp: Pi (and Oh My Pi when sharing pi-mcp-adapter) read ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json or project .mcp.json. Prefer user-global ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json so pi + omp both see jcodemunch.
_smoke: In OpenCode/pi: list jcodemunch tools, then fetch a known symbol (e.g. usage_snapshot path) without full-file read.
